texts.preamble: Sunil Bhausaheb Yevale vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 11 September, 2025 1 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad. 913 Anticipatory Bail Application No.1576 Of 2025 Sunil Bhausaheb Yevale ... Applicant Versus The State Of Maharashtra And Another ... Respondents ..... Shri. Sudheer Ramdas Zambare, Advocate for the Applicant Shri. B. B. Bhise, App for the Respondents - State. ... Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J. Dated : September 11, 2025 Per Court :- . Since the Applicant is apprehending arrest in C.R. No.0354/2025 registered with Akole Police Station, Dist. Ahilyanagar for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (for short, 'Bns') and Sec. 26 (2)(iv), 27 (3)(d), 27 (3) (e), 30(2)(a), 3 (1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he has filed this Application for Anticipatory Bail.
texts.facts: 3. The investigating machinery seized the Gutkha Pan Masala, Cash and Mobiles of the concerned persons and Vehicles. The Applicant is not named in the FIR. The role attributed to the Applicant as seen from the 2 papers on record is that, he had transported the said Articles. Except the Sunil Bhausaheb Yevale vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 11 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15453566/ 1 offence punishable under Section 123 of the BNS, rest of the Sections are bailable. As far as the Applicant is concerned, the essential ingredients for the offence punishable under Section 123 are not attracted. The Co-accused by name Atik alias Akib alias Don Mohammed Shaikh who is also not named in the FIR, is protected by this Court by order dated 14.08.2025 passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1409 of 2025.
